title: Full support of a product distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$ that assigns positive mass to every element, and let $n$ be a natural number. Then the product distribution of $n$ independent samples from $\pi$ assigns positive mass to every function from $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ to $\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$ with full support
